title: A refactor
hint: coding, easy — a cheap model is enough
prompt:
Refactor this so it stops hitting the database inside the loop:

def order_totals(order_ids):
    totals = []
    for oid in order_ids:
        order = db.query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?", oid)
        items = db.query("SELECT * FROM items WHERE order_id = ?", oid)
        totals.append((order.id, sum(i.price * i.qty for i in items)))
    return totals

title: A summary
hint: summarisation — a category with no dedicated benchmark
prompt: Summarise in five bullet points, for a non-technical founder: prompt caching means a provider keeps the tokens it has already processed, so sending the same prefix again is billed at roughly a tenth of the input price. The cache lives on one provider and one model, usually expires after five minutes, and needs a minimum prefix of about 1024 tokens. Switching model mid-conversation throws the cache away and the whole prefix is billed again at full price.
